name: Muren Stormpike
summary: In Ironforge, Muren Stormpike awaits warriors sent from Kharanos for formal training. Granis Swiftaxe sends recruits who have proved their mettle in Dun Morogh to the city's Military Ward.

sections.title: A Summons to Ironforge
sections.body: Granis Swiftaxe sends promising warriors from Kharanos to Ironforge after they face local threats in Dun Morogh. He knows rough skirmishes can teach only so much. In the Military Ward, senior fighters oversee formal training for those bound for battle.

sections.title: The Master of Arms
sections.body: At the Hall of Arms, you meet Muren Stormpike, a veteran of a storied dwarven clan. He wants proof that his new charges can endure real combat, not tavern tales. Reporting to him opens the way to learn defensive arts, control an enemy's aggression, and earn iron arms for the front line.

faq.q: Who sends you to find Muren Stormpike?
aliases: where do i get muren stormpike
faq.answer: Granis Swiftaxe, the warrior trainer in Kharanos, sends you after you prove your basic fighting skill in Dun Morogh.
Muren Stormpike is in the Hall of Arms, in the Military Ward on Ironforge's eastern side.

faq.q: Why is this quest important for warriors?
faq.answer: Reporting to Muren begins advanced warrior training. It leads to instruction in Defensive Stance and Taunt, along with a reliable early weapon.
Muren Stormpike is a veteran combat instructor in Ironforge and a member of the Stormpike clan, a renowned dwarven family of warriors and expeditionary engineers.

faq.q: Can any class take this quest?
aliases: can non warriors do muren stormpike
faq.answer: No. Only warrior novices ready for specialized martial training can take it.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Muren?
aliases: what is next after muren stormpike
faq.answer: After you speak with Muren, he tests your resolve by sending you into a combat trial against Vejrek.

angles.text: As a warrior, this summons marks your passage from recruit to disciplined soldier, ready to hold the line and protect allies.
As a dwarf fighter, reporting to the Hall of Arms connects you with the martial traditions and tactical discipline of the mountain clans.
As a gnomish warrior, you rely on Ironforge's Hall of Arms to learn traditional heavy frontline combat after the fall of Gnomeregan drove your people to Dun Morogh.
